correctness.rationale: Root-of-unity DFT resolves all but the top harmonic; the two Nyquist equations have determinant −sin(dα). Their inversion recovers full intensities. Two-circle reflection identities force a rational quotient invariant under nontrivial positive dilation, hence unimodular constant. Resonance and degenerate-radius counterexamples prove necessity. Explicit reconstructed formula tested 5148 times; finite tests are not the proof.

It neither rebrands the known 4d count nor uses an arbitrary numerical slice.
